name: Maitri Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Maitri Enterprises Ltd trades in Pharmaceutical & Medical Goods.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MEL is engaged in trading of Pharmaceutical & Medical Goods in Gujarat. This includes sale of service by way of works contract. Apart from this, the co. is also in the business of Infra
structure and Real Estate.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.45 times its book value
